scope: Six short audience-facing slides for session 07, centered on Digital Mine. A declared synthetic eight-cycle teaching fixture supports the haulage chart. Construction of the generator and practical analysis stay outside the presentation. No model calls, real mine measurements or simulator execution.

sources.title: What is EDA?
sources.supports: Exploration as an approach to understanding structure, variation and assumptions, with graphical techniques.

sources.title: Detection of Outliers
sources.supports: Investigating unusual observations rather than automatically treating them as errors.

sources.title: Scatter Plot
sources.supports: Association between variables does not establish a causal effect.

sources.title: Working with missing data
sources.supports: Explicit handling of missing values. Complementary reference; no pandas dependency is required by the slides.

sources.title: Good enough practices in scientific computing
sources.authors: Greg Wilson, Jennifer Bryan, Karen Cranston, Justin Kitzes, Lex Nederbragt and Tracy K. Teal
sources.supports: Preserving original data, recording processing steps, organizing scripts and making dependencies explicit.

sources.title: What is data engineering?
sources.supports: Building and operating data pipelines and systems that provide reliable, accessible data.

sources.title: What is data science?
sources.supports: Statistics, programming and domain expertise; modeling, exploration and collaboration across overlapping data roles.

sources.title: What is synthetic data?
sources.supports: Artificial data generation; the course fixture uses explicit rules and does not claim to preserve a measured distribution.

sources.title: How do I read and write tabular data?
sources.supports: DataFrames and reading/writing common data formats; referenced as an analysis tool, not a slide dependency.

sources.title: SQL Introduction
sources.supports: SQL query processing; an example of a local query engine rather than a prescribed project stack.

sources.title: Python graphing and data visualization
sources.supports: Library for interactive charts; referenced as a tool, not used to render the slide chart.

sources.title: Intro
sources.supports: Coding agent, project context and iterative work; capabilities depend on tools and permissions.

synthetic_example.title: Digital Mine: illustrative haulage cycles
synthetic_example.origin: Authored teaching fixture with explicitly selected rules and values, not a measurement or digital twin simulator output.
synthetic_example.grain: One completed haulage cycle including initial queue and empty return.
synthetic_example.units: Durations in minutes, payload in metric tonnes, timestamps UTC.
synthetic_example.method: Fixed values declared in fixture metadata; no fitted distribution or stochastic seed.

aggregations.grouping: Arithmetic mean per cycle and route; four cycles per route.

synthetic_example.limitations: Rules deliberately create a difference between routes. No inference of real congestion, mine capacity, productivity or calibrated behavior.
